A farm scripting its whole farm fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 220 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. Submissions that land within 98 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. That is 26 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
